# 🗂️ Data Analysis Portfolio

Welcome! This is my personal portfolio of end-to-end data analysis projects using Python, SQL, R, and various machine learning libraries.  
Each project is self-contained and demonstrates real-world data wrangling, modeling, and visualization.

## 📁 Projects

| No. | Project | Description | Tools |
|-----|---------|-------------|-------|
| 01 | [`project_01_titanic_ml_project`](./project_01_titanic_ml_project) | Predicting survival on the Titanic using classical ML models | Python, pandas, scikit-learn |
| 02 | [`project_02_TMDB_Movies`](./project_02_TMDB_Movies) | ROI analysis of movies using SQL + Python pipeline | SQL, SQLite, pandas, matplotlib |
| 03 | [`project_03_Boston_House_Prices`](./project_03_Boston_House_Prices) | Regression analysis on Boston housing dataset | Python, seaborn, sklearn |
| 04 | [`project_04_Credit_Card_Fraud_Detection`](./project_04_Credit_Card_Fraud_Detection) | Detecting anomalies in credit card transactions | Python, sklearn, SMOTE |
| 05 | [`project_05_Amazon_Fine_Food_Reviews`](./project_05_Amazon_Fine_Food_Reviews) | NLP sentiment analysis on Amazon food reviews | Python, NLP, wordcloud, LSTM (optional) |

## 🛠️ Tools & Libraries

`Python`, `pandas`, `scikit-learn`, `matplotlib`, `seaborn`, `sqlite3`, `SQL`, `Jupyter`, `R`, `NLTK`, `TensorFlow` *(project-dependent)*
